jobs.title: Corporate Strategy Director
jobs.description:
Corporate Strategy Director

The Corporate Strategy team at Land O’Lakes works closely with the top leaders of our Cooperative to help them solve their most critical strategic problems. The team oversees designing strategic initiatives for the whole enterprise and each business unit, as well as analyzing how changing market conditions affect our businesses and what we can do about it. This team also leads the Corporate strategic planning process on behalf of the Executive Leadership Team and the Board of Directors.

Position Overview:
Reporting directly to the Chief Strategy Officer, the Corporate Strategy Director will play a pivotal role in driving the long-term strategic vision and growth trajectory of our organization. This position is instrumental in aligning corporate objectives with market realities, identifying strategic initiatives, and fostering a culture of innovation and agility.

This role is located at our Arden Hills, MN Corporate Headquarters (Tuesday-Thursday in office each week)

Key Responsibilities:
- Strategic Planning: Lead the development and implementation of corporate strategic plans in alignment with organizational goals, market trends, and competitive dynamics. Continuously assess and refine strategies to ensure responsiveness to evolving business landscapes.
- Market Analysis: Partner with Economic Research team to develop comprehensive market analysis, including competitor benchmarking, industry trends, and customer insights. Translate findings into actionable recommendations to inform strategic decision-making processes.
- Business Development: Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, partnerships, and investment avenues to drive revenue growth and market expansion. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess feasibility, mitigate risks, and execute strategic initiatives.
- Performance Monitoring: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to track the effectiveness of strategic initiatives. Monitor performance against targets and provide regular updates to executive leadership, identifying areas for optimization and course correction.
- Organizational Alignment: Foster a culture of strategic thinking and alignment across departments and business units. Collaborate with senior leadership to cascade strategic objectives throughout the organization and ensure cohesive execution at all levels.
- Risk Management: Anticipate and mitigate strategic risks by conducting scenario planning, stress testing, and risk assessments. Develop contingency plans to address potential disruptions and safeguard organizational resilience.
- Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including investors, board members, industry associations, and regulatory bodies. Represent the organization in strategic discussions, conferences, and networking events.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or related field required. MBA preferred.
- Proven track record of at least 10 years of experience in corporate strategy/related roles or 5+ years of management consulting. Experience in a matrixed organization preferred.
- Demonstrated people leadership experience required, with a track record of leading cross-functional teams and driving results in a dynamic environment.
- Deep understanding of industry dynamics, market trends, and competitive landscapes.
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
- Exceptional strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.

$163,520-$245,280.  In most cases, candidates offered employment can expect to be hired at a pay rate near the middle of our salary ranges.

jobs.title: General Manager, EPL Feed
jobs.description:
General Manager, EPL Feed

The General Manager (GM) is responsible for the overall strategic leadership, operational excellence, and financial performance of EPL Feed. This role oversees everything from mill production and ingredient procurement to nutritional consulting services and fleet logistics. The GM ensures that EPL Feed remains the premier partner for regional dairy and livestock producers by delivering high-quality, custom nutritional solutions and maintaining a culture of safety and integrity.

This role is based at EPL Feed in Sumas, WA. A relocation package will be provided.

Key Responsibilities
1. Operational Leadership & Strategy
- Lead long-term strategic planning to expand market share and modernize facility infrastructure.
- Ensure there are well established metrics and review on a regular cadence the operational performance of the two feed mills.
- Through the plant managers, ensure the mills safely deliver high-quality, cost-efficient products.
- Deliver a high level of customer service while optimizing fleet performance and efficiency.

2. Financial & Business Management
- Full P&L responsibility, including budgeting, forecasting, and capital expenditure planning.
- Improve return on investment through disciplined expense management, sales growth, and operational efficiency initiatives.
- Ensure the team actively monitors commodity markets to optimize ingredient procurement and manage price risk.
- Drive sales growth by maintaining high-level relationships with key dairy accounts and identifying new business opportunities in the Pacific Northwest.
- Regularly report financial progress and plans business strategy in partnership with the Board of Directors.

3. Nutrition & Quality Assurance
- Maintain strict adherence to industry regulations, including FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
- Ensure all custom mixes and commodity blends meet the standards the company is known for.

4. People & Culture
- Foster a high-performance culture rooted in transparency, mutual respect, and safety.
- Directly manage and mentor department heads across Production, Sales, Logistics, Finance and Administration.
- Support talent acquisition, retention, and succession planning to ensure the organization is staffed with capable and empowered team members.
- Ensure the company upholds the highest standards of integrity, compliance, safety, and customer service.

5. Community & Stakeholder Relations
- Serve as the primary face of EPL Feed within the local agricultural community and industry associations (e.g., Washington State Dairy Federation).
- Manage emergency response and business continuity planning (e.g., environmental or logistical disruptions) to ensure uninterrupted service to livestock producers.

Required Qualifications:
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Animal Science, Agribusiness, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree in Ruminant Nutrition is a plus.
- Experience: 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in agribusiness, preferably within feed mill operations, dairy nutrition, or agricultural retail.
- Technical Skills: Strong understanding of commodity markets, feed formulation software, and ERP systems.
- Leadership: Proven ability to lead diverse team which includes feed mill operators, CDL drivers, nutritionists, and sales teams.
- Personal Attributes: A "boots-on-the-ground" leadership style; exceptional communication skills; and a deep commitment to the success of the regional farming community.

Physical Requirements:
- Ability to work in a mill environment, which may include exposure to grain dust, loud machinery, and varying weather conditions.
- Occasional travel to client farms and regional industry events.

$163,520-$245,280.  In most cases, candidates offered employment can expect to be hired at a pay rate near the middle of our salary ranges.

jobs.title: Corporate Strategy MBA Intern, Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Corporate Strategy MBA Intern, Summer 2027

When you join Land O’Lakes as an intern, you are joining a Fortune 250 agribusiness and food production leader with more than 100 years of operations as a farmer- and member-owned cooperative. With business units spanning crop insights, animal nutrition, dairy foods, and sustainability solutions, you will gain a purpose-driven, hands-on internship experience.

The Corporate Strategy MBA Intern will be based in Arden Hills, MN and takes place for approximately 10 weeks (June – August 2027).  Relocation assistance provided for eligible candidates.

The Corporate Strategy and Business Development team at Land O’Lakes leads high-profile projects and initiatives sponsored by Land O’Lakes Executive Leadership Team to support enterprise and business unit strategy and growth.  The team serves as trusted, internal consultants across three disciplines – strategy formulation, industry and competitive insights, and M&A – to have a significant impact on the company’s strategy and performance.

As a Corporate Strategy MBA Intern, you will:
- Contribute to business-critical projects that will test your ability to think strategically, glean insights from data, and deliver a recommendation to business leadership.

- Engage in mentorship and professional development programming throughout the summer.

- Expand your professional network and connect directly with Land O’Lakes senior leadership team.

- Deliver a final presentation of your project recommendations to business leaders at the conclusion of the summer internship.

Experience-Education (Required)
- A current first year MBA student with an expected graduation date of Spring or Summer 2028

- Track record of outstanding performance while working on high-impact projects and initiatives, including project management experience

Competencies-Skills (Required)
- Curious and Analytical - Intellectually curious with the ability to go beyond surface-level information to seek and understand key insights and business implications; Ability to track down primary/secondary research, analyze data, and synthesize findings

- Business Acumen - Experience using quantitative and qualitative strategic and financial frameworks to analyze the attractiveness and potential of growth opportunities. Foundational knowledge and exposure to multiple business disciplines (i.e. marketing, supply chain, or finance/accounting)

- Driven and Results-Oriented - Sense of urgency and flexibility to meet tight deadlines while juggling multiple priorities

- Strong Collaborator - Team player; Track record of quickly gaining credibility, partnering with business leaders; Able to effectively lead and contribute to cross-functional teams through influence

- Excellent Communicator - Demonstrated professional confidence, communication and presentation skills when interfacing with executive leadership; Proven ability to articulate business strategies

- Self-Starter - Must be highly motivated with the ability to work through ambiguity; commitment to consistent, high-quality results

Competencies-Skills (Preferred)
- Previous food and agribusiness experience desirable

- Prior consulting experience preferred

The hourly rate for this 10 week internship is $60.00/hour.

Essential Functions/Work Environment:
Hybrid Work Environment; minimum 3 days at Arden Hills, MN: Tuesday – Thursday weekly.

Application Instructions
Resume and cover letter are required when submitting application

Application Deadline: Friday January 8, 2027 by 11:59PM Central Time

Applications will be reviewed in January 2027. Due to the number of applicants, communication will be limited to those candidates who are advancing in the evaluation process.

jobs.title: Finance Manager - Dairy Foods
jobs.description:
Finance Manager - Dairy Foods

Land O'Lakes Dairy Foods Finance Team is seeking a strategic and result-oriented Finance Manager to support our Milk Powders business. In this individual contributor role, you will provide strategic financial leadership, rigorous performance insight, and operational decision support to senior leaders and cross- functional partners. In addition, you will partner closely with the Global Dairy Ingredients Senior Finance Manager to lead routine monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for the business, facilitate cross-functional risk-management discussions, and support key growth strategies through advanced modeling and actionable insights.

This role is located at our Arden Hills, MN corporate headquarters (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday in office each week)

Key responsibilities include:
- Own monthly reporting and analysis of key financial and operational performance drivers, with emphasis on root causes and forward-looking implications
- Lead the annual budget, periodic forecast, and long-range planning processes for the Milk Powders business, including alignment of key assumptions across functional leaders
- Facilitate cross-functional risk-management discussions, framing financial exposures, market scenario analysis, and recommended action steps for leadership consideration
- Serve as a key finance partner to internal stakeholders including the Director of Sales and sales team, supply chain, supply chain finance, risk management, planning, strategic ops, marketing, and Dairy Accounting
- Partner with business leadership to shape financial priorities, evaluate strategic alternatives, build out financial business cases for capital investments, and connect near-term operating decisions to long-range business objectives.
- Collaborate with milk supply team on milk balancing decisions as it relates to pricing for ultrafiltered milk and condensed skim products

Experience/Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting or related field is required. MBA or CPA desired.
- A minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience required.
- Advanced skills in financial return modeling across both the P&L and Balance Sheet.
- Advanced Excel Skills. Hyperion and/or OneStream highly desired.
- Previous work experience supporting agriculture industry and commodity market environment preferred

Competencies:
- Ability to synthesize dynamic inputs like changing commodity market conditions into key recommendations with clear impacts and implications.
- Connects business decisions to broader enterprise economics, strategy, risk, and long-term value creation.
- Ability to take an enterprise view of the value chain and build strong relationships.
- Self-starter with a bias for action, able to work independently as finance partner within a matrixed operating environment.

$107,680-$161,520.  In most cases, candidates offered employment can expect to be hired at a pay rate near the middle of our salary ranges.

jobs.description:
Operations Manager

Sign-bonus: $10,000 split between two payments; $5,000 within 30 days of starting and $5,000 after 6 months of employment.

The Land O’Lakes Supply Chain & Operations division provides strategic leadership across the company’s many business units. The team plays a significant role in fueling revenue growth and profitability through operational excellence, quality, process improvement and innovation. By partnering closely with Finance, Marketing and Human Resources, the team delivers value to Land O’Lakes business units, members and customers.

Position Purpose:
Mentor, coach and train team members to develop effective and efficient teams. Ensure appropriate, effective communication within teams, across teams and to management as well as support areas. Develop flexible, multi-skilled team members to enable movement of people as needed to accomplish work. Collaborate with Plant Steering Team to develop and implement short and long term strategies, including project leadership, staffing and employee engagement.
This role is responsible for leading a production team comprised of three production supervisors, one warehouse supervisor, and 40 hourly associates with the goal of creating a strong safety culture, positive employee relations & engagement and consistency throughout each of the teams.

Competencies-Skills (Required):
- Strong Microsoft Office suite and written communication skills
- Ability to communicate with a variety of people & personalities
- Must be able to make quick decisions on the spot & support those decisions to your peers, employees, and plant leadership
- Ability to consistently meet deadlines
- Ability to manage multiple projects & multi-task with ease
- Must be detail oriented and have excellent follow through
- Results orientation with track record of successful achievements
- Active listening skills is a must
- Ability to influence a positive employee environment
- Ability to drive safety & safe behaviors while maintaining the ultimate goal of preventing all injuries

- Must have flexible schedule and availability

- Must have strong leadership skills and strategic planning skills.
- Must be respected by peers, co-workers, vendors, and internal and external customers.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Operations Manager

The  Operations Manager will manage and maintain 24-hour responsibility for Powder / Fluids production, Warehousing, and operations effectiveness. Manages, mentors, coaches, and trains approximately 200 team members to develop effective and efficient teams by driving production improvement projects, plant safety initiatives, and cost performance programs. Also responsible for providing tactical and decision-making support to the Plant Manager and core operations team members.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
- Develops and directs programs to ensure the efficient and cost-effective operation and utilization of facility.

- Manages safety, quality, service, and cost performance within assigned area.

- Ensures compliance with the organization's policies and procedures.

- Makes recommendations to senior management on long range labor strategies and capital equipment needs.

- Develops and implements recommendations to change systems, policies, and procedures; ensure timely and accurate implementation.

- Prepares and maintains accurate, timely and complete documentation regarding all aspects of production.

- Collaborates with Human Resources in employee relations matters and ensures consistent application of policy expectations.

- Implements strategies and tactics that align with department and company vision and goals.

- Develops and maintains operating budget and capital spending plans for assigned area of responsibility.

- Identifies, obtains, and develops staff capabilities needed to consistently meet departmental objectives.

- Ensures industry best practices are applied and employees are trained accordingly.

- Responsible for understanding and complying with applicable quality, environmental and safety regulatory considerations. Also responsible for ensuring HALAL and Kosher compliance in the Carlisle facility and GMPs.

- This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict other tasks that may be assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Develops, coaches and mentor subordinate staff.

- Conducts performance evaluations; recommends salary adjustments; rewards employees or takes disciplinary action, as necessary; addresses complaints and resolves issues.

REQUIRED COMPETENCIES/SKILLS:
- Ability to communicate with a variety of people & personalities

- Must be able to make quick decisions on the spot & support those decisions to your peers, employees, and plant leadership

- Ability to consistently meet deadlines

- Ability to manage multiple projects & multi-task with ease

- Must be detail oriented and have excellent follow through

- Active listening skills are a must

- Ability to influence a positive employee environment

- Ability to drive safety & safe behaviors while maintaining the goal of preventing all injuries

- Must be able to influence & drive change management

- High speed manufacturing experience

REQUIRED EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:
- Bachelor's degree required and 7+ years of supervisory/management experience in food processing/manufacturing operations with solid progressive leadership experience.

- Strong presentation, communication, training, and interpersonal skills.

- Proven track record of understanding the drivers of product and labor cost variances.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
- MBA or master’s degree in Engineering, preferred.

- Experience working in a 24/7 environment highly preferred.

- Knowledge of reading, analyzing, and interpreting technical and business journals, financial reports, and legal documents.

- Experience responding to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community.

- Experience defining problems, collecting data, establishing facts, and drawing valid conclusions.

- Proven ability to work with all levels and functions within the company.

- Skilled in project management.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Operations Manager

This role is part of our Omnium business who is a loyal partner in the manufacturing of crop protection, adjuvant, and plant nutrition products.

The Operations Manager provides leadership and management to the production departments and oversees all manufacturing activities to meet safety, environmental, quality, production, customer service, and cost objectives. Manages process introductions, production schedule, production procedures and continuous improvement efforts for each manufacturing area.  Provides guidance and direction to production staff’s training and development needs in order to maintain a competitive and competent workforce within the departments.

Operations:   Provide leadership within the process areas in an effort to drive process performance and improvements to achieve maximized business profitability by increasing throughputs, reducing losses, and improving overall morale. Develop and/or approve production batch procedures to ensure quality products are produced in a safe and effective manner. Responsible for meeting budgeted financial plans, controlling expenses and minimizing facility repairs.  Provide customer support and liaison with the customer support group to ensure that their needs are addressed satisfactory.  Prepare and analyze various weekly and monthly reports.  Other duties as assigned.

EHS:  Responsible for following and enforcing company environmental, health and safety policies.  Enforce work rules fairly and consistently.  Provides leadership and participation in process safety related management programs.  Participates in and is responsible for production related actions associated with hazard analysis and process safety reviews.  Ensures that all production departments complete pre-production startup reviews and environmental, safety and health related pre-startup protocols.

Staff/Staffing:  Manage department leaders and direct labor to provide maximum throughput while minimizing costs.  Ensure products are produced in accordance with plant schedule and required product specifications.  Instill accountability in employees to perform at a higher level.  Maintain and update production protocols at the customer’s request.

Customer Service: Help build and maintain business relationships that provide growth within the company. Maintain excellent customer service and improve work strategies that strengthen our business expertise. Help develop and maintain competitive pricing strategies to maximize profits while enticing new business.

Technical:   Understand operational and technical issues and work directly with plant management and the technical group to identify required objectives and allocate resources appropriately.  Facilitate and aid upcoming equipment or system changes driven by business cost reductions, product innovations/renovations and shifts in inventory management.  Responsible for the safe introduction of new processes and products into the facility.

Required Education/Experience:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field and 5+ years of manufacturing leadership experience; OR a high school diploma/GED 8+ years of manufacturing leadership experience.
- Ability to interpret financial accounting information.
- Must have excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Must have talent management and development skills
- Proficient skills with spread sheets, email and Microsoft Office programs
- Familiarity with training in emergency response and incident commander responsibilities
- Must be knowledgeable with general industry OSHA and EPA regulations
- Knowledge in process safety management, risk management and FIFRA regulations are desirable
- Demonstrated understanding of supply chain systems, supply/customer agreements
- ERP knowledge helpful

Preferred Education/Experience:
- Bachelors degree in Chemical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering
- Chemical manufacturing leadership experience

Salary: $93,360 - $140,040
In most cases, candidates offered employment can expect to be hired at a pay rate near the middle of our salary ranges

jobs.title: Quality, Food Safety & Sanitation Program Manager
jobs.description:
Quality, Food Safety & Sanitation Program Manager The Quality, Food Safety & Sanitation Program Manager is responsible for leading all Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Regulatory, and Sanitation activities associated with the implementation of new processing technology across multiple dairy manufacturing facilities. This role serves as the primary quality and regulatory representative for a multi-year capital project, partnering with Engineering, Operations, R&D, Manufacturing, and external regulatory agencies to ensure new equipment, processes, and products are designed, validated, and launched in compliance with food safety, quality, customer, and regulatory requirements. The position is accountable for developing and implementing quality systems, sanitation programs, regulatory compliance strategies, environmental monitoring requirements, testing programs, and customer readiness processes necessary to successfully commission and commercialize new manufacturing capabilities.

This role can be based in Arden Hills, MN (preferred) or Virtual.

Key Focus Areas:
- Quality, Food Safety, and Regulatory Leadership - Strong Collaboration and Partnership with other key members of the quality team
- Quality and Food Safety Systems Development and Implementation
- Regulatory and Customer Readiness
- Laboratory and Testing Plan Development
- Support of Hygienic Design, Commissioning, and Validations of all new equipment and processes.
- Support Master Sanitation Implementation and Training
- Training, Education, and Team Building
- Large focus on details, communication, and reporting to senior leadership in order to streamline decision making and maintenance of timelines. Must be highly meticulous, precise and analytical.
- Others as required by business needs

Required Experience/Knowledge/Skills:
- Bachelor’s degree in food science, Dairy Science, Microbiology, Biological Sciences, Engineering, or related technical discipline.
- 7+ years of experience in dairy, food manufacturing, quality assurance, food safety, sanitation, or regulatory compliance. In lieu of degree, 12+ years of experience in dairy, food manufacturing, quality assurance, food safety, sanitation, or regulatory compliance.
- Experience implementing quality systems in manufacturing environments.
- Strong knowledge of: HACCP, Preventive Controls, Environmental Monitoring Programs, Sanitary/Hygienic Design.
- Regulatory inspections and compliance, Dairy manufacturing operations, demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects.

Preferred Experience/Knowledge/Skills:
- Experience with major capital projects, plant expansions, or new facility start-ups. PCQI certification.
- Experience supporting FDA and state regulatory inspections.
- Experience with laboratory setup and analytical testing programs.
- Knowledge of dry dairy processing and milk powder manufacturing along with butter processing and manufacturing.

Travel and Other Requirements: This role will have approximately 50-70% travel. Travel will be highly dictated by project type, project location(s), and timeline demand. Travel will be fully in the US. Some working hours may be during off shifts depending on timeline demand and project deliverables. Candidate will need to be flexible in working hours and travel. This role will have a working environment that is a mix of office setting, manufacturing environment, and construction environment - associate must be comfortable in all these settings.

jobs.title: Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) TAP Associate
jobs.description:
Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) TAP Associate

FINANCIAL PLANNING & ANALYSIS (FP&A) TAP ASSOCIATE
The Land O'Lakes Finance organization is currently seeking candidates to join our organization in a Talent Acceleration Program (TAP) Associate role.   This role will provide the opportunity to learn a variety of tasks and functions within our Finance organization.  The TAP program is designed to offer two defined rotational assignments in our Finance and Accounting areas.
